model.model_identity: published catalog alias; immutable weights not attested

evidence.base: Unchanged frozen B004 Leiden means-plus-fractions evidence and query groups
evidence.means: Cluster mean arcsinh(processed X/5), standardized using the frozen four B004 training regions; integer thousandths
evidence.fractions: Fraction processed X>0 before transformation/standardization; integer thousandths
evidence.neighborhood: Add exactly the previously prepared Opus–Leiden measured-neighborhood vectors and definition: up to15 nearest other cells within region, distance ties resolved by numeric cell ID, measured arcsinh(X/5), cluster averaged and standardized with the frozen B004 training scaler

analysis.baseline: Reuse four accepted blinded Astra–Leiden means-plus-fractions items, never regenerate
analysis.endpoint: equal-weighted agreement across two fixed B004 test regions
analysis.missing_predictions: remain errors in planned denominator, distinct from valid Noise label
analysis.multiplicity: single-generation descriptive matched controls; no repeatability claim

unrelated_scope: B005/B006 work and all existing active runners/configurations remain unchanged
